note: The description is taken from Snyder's 1924 original description of Nasutitermes (Subulitermes) zeteki (in English); it is based on soldiers only (type specimen U.S.N.M. No. 25766), and the original states that the alate is unknown; type locality Summit, Canal Zone, Panama. The species is now placed in the genus Araujotermes, the author having placed it in the subgenus Subulitermes of Nasutitermes. The original is in Latin and was OCR'd from the BHL scan: Roman and Arabic numerals are mixed (e.g. "I" means 1), and decimal points were occasionally misread as commas. Doubtful readings are not recorded.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Only the soldier is known (the alate is unknown); the first species of the subgenus Subulitermes found in Central America; body small (soldier body length 2.2—3.1 mm), the head pale yellow and slender, the nasus chestnut brown, slender, long and straight; antennae with only 11 segments; mandibles absent; head and body densely covered with long and short setae; body colour white with yellow.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellow, with a nasus, slender, gradually narrowing forwards but slightly thicker (higher) at the front end, covered with dense long and short hairs; nasus chestnut brown, slender, straight, densely covered with short hairs from base to apex and on both the dorsal and ventral surfaces; mandibles absent. Antennae white with yellow, 11-segmented, covered with short hairs, the segments gradually wider and longer from base to apex: segment 1 long and wide, four-cylindrical; segment 2 shorter than segment 1; segment 3 subclavate, slender, slightly longer than segments 2 and 4 and slightly thinner; segment 4 subclavate, slightly longer than segment 2; terminal segment slender, nearly oval. Pronotum white with yellow, more yellow at the anterior margin, saddle-shaped, much narrower than the head, with long setae. Legs white with yellow, rather long and slender, covered with short hairs. Abdomen greyish white with yellow, densely covered on both surfaces with short pale yellow setae, with long setae at the sides of the base of each segment. Measurements: soldier body length 2.2—3.1 mm; head length (including the nasus) 0.95—1.1 mm; head length (excluding the nasus) 0.6—0.7 mm; nasus length 0.35—0.38 mm; pronotum length 0.11 mm, width 0.27 mm; head width 0.42—0.46 mm; hind tibia length 0.45—0.50 mm.
